<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Take the information below and generate an agent instructions .md file for it in the /docs directory. If a .md filename is provided, use that, otherwise generate an appropriate filename based on the generated content. The generated instructions should be concise, clear, and not too long. Make sure to update the AGENTS.md file to reference this new docs file. If no information is provided below, prompt the user to give necessary details about the layer of architecture or coding standards to document.
